method: Independent integrated assessment A: /root/impeccable_current_visual_a; root coordinates parallel integration review separately. Actual browser evidence, source inspection, and viewed owner-frozen story frames. No detector score used.
verdict: A materially improved, personal desktop journey with verified core interactions. It is not a complete high-end visual pass: Hero p.35 remains a busy double exposure. The new FirstConversation is clearer and better paced but remains restrained SVG/typographic storytelling. The actual mesh deformation and short camera dolly are real and modest; the approved B-room remains a rigid illustration, not reconstructed immersive 3D.
specificity: Authored for Yeonseok and Lisbeth: approved couple portraits, Gwangju/Santo Domingo, truthful InterPals/rude-start/12-hour facts, eight shared games, actual drawn signature, and rose response. It would not survive a mere company-name swap. Some connective motion is still more schematic than the richness of the protected art.

emotionalJourney: Large cosmic opening → familiar shared B-room → honest imperfect beginning → duration of contact → living with a 13-hour difference → invitation to play → personal letter and signed pact → rose gift. Strong personal arrival and payoff; p.35 ghosting weakens the first major handoff. The refined ink chapter supplies a calmer factual bridge, not a second cinematic spectacle.
